author_direction: Kirk LaSalle selected Candidates A and B, one active at a time, with B active on 2026-10-16, and asked that B be put to the test against real public data.
registration_scope: Local prospective numerical preregistration, frozen by SHA-256 before the ATLAS Figure 4 contour coordinates were retrieved into this workspace. It is not an external registry entry.

model.bulk_potential: V_bulk = m5^2 Phi^2 / 2 on flat R^(3,1) x S^1_R; bulk self-interactions set to zero at the matching scale (restricted tree-level closure, not radiative closure)
model.brane_potential: V_H = lambda (H^dagger H - v^2/2)^2 with lambda = m_h0^2/(2 v^2)
model.portal: -g_xi xi_b (H^dagger H - v^2/2), reduced to -sum_n mu_n phi_n (v h + h^2/2), mu_0 = mu_4, mu_n = sqrt(2) mu_4 for n >= 1
model.basis: (h, phi_0, phi_1c, ..., phi_Nc); sine modes vanish at the brane and decouple
model.cubic_couplings: d^3V/dh^3 = 6 lambda v = 3 m_h0^2 / v; d^3V/dh^2 dphi_n = mu_n; no other tree-level scalar cubic terms
model.mass_matching: solve for the unmixed m_h0 so the lightest eigenmass equals M_H exactly
model.rate_prediction: the observed Higgs state has kappa_V = kappa_F = kappa = |U_h1|, with no additional decay width because every other state is heavier than M_H
model.heavy_widths: on-shell two-scalar widths from the full cubic tensor; tree-level on-shell WW, ZZ and t tbar widths scaled by U_hi^2; the sum is a lower bound on each total width because bb, gg, gamma gamma, off-shell and loop channels are omitted

constants.source: PDG Review of Particle Physics 2024 central values; M_H = 125.09 GeV is the ATLAS-CMS Run-1 combined mass, with 125.2 GeV as a sensitivity probe

parameter_grid.tower_levels: N_Lambda = floor(R sqrt(Lambda^2 - m5^2)); require N_Lambda >= 1
parameter_grid.mu4_scan: for each grid point, the coupling mu_4 is the constrained quantity; scan monotonically from 0 by bisection on kappa(mu_4)
parameter_grid.choice_basis: R^-1 spans three decades, m5 spans 1.2 M_H to 1.2 TeV and Lambda matches the 3 TeV upper edge of the CMS-HIG-24-002 window; no value was chosen from the ATLAS contour

validity_flags.isolation: lightest additional eigenmass >= 130 GeV for applying the 125 GeV Higgs-rate product
validity_flags.brane_coefficient_convention: |mu5/sqrt(Lambda)| < 1, with mu5 = mu4 sqrt(2 pi R); reported as a convention flag, not an exclusion
validity_flags.brane_quartic_convention: lambda_0 = m_h0^2/(2 v^2) <= 1; reported as a working perturbativity flag

comparison.data_product: ATLAS Nature 607 (2022) 52, HEPData 10.17182/hepdata.130266.v1/t4, observed 95% CL joint contour in (kappa_V, kappa_F) without invisible or undetected decays
comparison.statistic: intersection of the segment {(k,k): 0 <= k <= 1} with the published observed 95% joint region
comparison.kappa_floor: kappa_lo = smallest k on that segment inside the region; translate to mu4_max(R, m5, Lambda) where kappa(mu4) = kappa_lo

outcome_rules.incompatible: empty intersection: the restricted hypothesis is incompatible with this published region for every parameter point
outcome_rules.compatible_with_limit: non-empty intersection: report kappa_lo, whether k=1 is inside, and mu4_max for each valid grid point
outcome_rules.ambiguous_data: missing observed 95% contour, open or unordered contour, or incompatible assumptions: stop and report

forbidden: choosing or optimizing grid points after reading the contour
quoting a B-specific one-parameter confidence interval or p-value
treating compatibility as confirmation of Candidate B
treating 68% contours or expected contours as the observed 95% result

deferred_tests.cms_hig_24_002_direct_resonance: requires mixed-state production cross sections and width-matched signal hypotheses; the heavy widths computed here are an input, not a test
deferred_tests.stxs_or_full_likelihood: requires a published likelihood or a validated reinterpretation product
